informal_statement:
For a planar carrier \(F\), define its canonical boundary measure by pulling Euclidean
\[
\mathcal H^1
\]
restricted to the frontier of its Euclidean image back to the coordinate plane.
reason: Source `CMVGeometry.lean:61-66`: The measure is determined by Euclidean Hausdorff measure restricted to the complete frontier and transported back; it is not selectable boundary data.
